info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Channel Activity Analysis API
info.description: The Channel Activity Analysis API enables businesses to analyze banking operations across various channels in real-time. By submitting analysis requests, financial institutions can uncover insights about customer interactions and channel performance. This service is essential for operations teams and data analysts looking to optimize service delivery and improve customer experience. Typical use cases include generating reports for strategic decision-making and enhancing operational insights through detailed channel performance metrics.

post.summary: Create a new channel activity analysis.
